teaser: A toolbox, lid open, waits on the neighbor's porch — the railing was going to get fixed before dinner. You carry life path 8, the Powerhouse, built to master the material world, inside an ISFJ, the Defender, built to notice what needs keeping. Ambition here rarely looks like a boardroom; it looks like someone who fixes the railing without being asked and keeps the receipt. Command gets folded into care, authority proven by what holds up quietly, year after year, rather than by what gets announced.
excerpt: Does loyalty get measured more by what gets provided than by what gets said?
